page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-2x.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance integrates dedicated hardware acceleration, featuring two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs with a combined video memory of 48 GB. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Given the inclusion of dual NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs alongside a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile optimized for parallel processing workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for resource-intensive tasks that require GPU acceleration without the overhead of local storage. Suitable workloads include machine learning inference, data science pipelines, rendering, and GPU-bound analytical databases.
